plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Art - Studio Art A.A. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 19, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7936/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local GE. Map states Total Units 59-60; lower bound 59 used = 15+14+15+15 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 2 Area L7B 2-3 -> 2). List A - Art History (minimum 6 units): ARTH C1100, ARTH 309 (advisory ENGL C1000), ARTH 311, ARTH 312, ARTH 328, ARTH 332 (advisory ENGL C1000), ARTH 333 — one 3-unit selection sequenced in each of Semesters 2 and 4 (map recommends ARTH 309 for Semester 2, ARTH 311 for Semester 4); a different course per slot. List B - Studio (minimum 12 units): ART 301, ART 302 (requires ART 300), ART 305 (requires ART 304), ART 312, ART 324, ART 327 (advisory ART 300), ART 328 (requires ART 327), ART 330, ART 336, ART 337 (requires ART 336), ART 338, ART 361, ART 362, ART 364, ART 372, ART 402, ART 404 (requires ART 402), ART 443 (enrollment limitation: 2 college art courses from ART or ARTH), ARTNM 324 (advisory: ART 300, ART 320, CISC 302 or JOUR 330), ARTNM 420 (advisory: ART 320 & 370) — one 3-unit selection in Semester 2, two in Semester 3, one in Semester 4 (map recommends ART 327 for the Semester 2 slot); a different course per slot. Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation.
